name: a finished run whose checks report 2, 4, 3, 1 gaps across 11 continuations ends with a draft pull request within budget
about: A small ticket finished its tasks, then spent hours and tens of dollars over many continuations with no pull request: every step re-ran the checks (the gap count rose and fell) and started fresh fix rounds. The draft opens first, a round that doesn't shrink the gaps ends fixing, and the run stops after its continuations allowance.
